title: B2B consolidators
headline: Grow your agent network without growing your back office
intro: Consolidators live on volume and credit control. TravelSuite ERP gives every agent a self-service portal while you keep markups, credit limits and balances under control.
challenges: Agents call or message for every booking
helps: B2B agent portal with net fares

seo.keywords: B2B travel portal, travel consolidator software, sub-agent management, agent credit limit software
overview: Consolidator software with a self-service B2B portal. Sub-agents search, book and issue on their own, while you control fares, markups, credit limits and deposits.
Agent ledgers update with every ticket, and aging reports show who owes what, protecting your cash flow as the network grows.
faqs: Can I set different markups for each agent?
Yes. Set markups by agent, agent group, airline or route.
What happens when an agent reaches the credit limit?
New bookings are blocked until they pay or top up their wallet.
Can agents download their statements?
Yes. Statements are available in the portal at any time.

seoTitle: B2B Travel Consolidator Software — TravelSuite ERP
metaDescription: Consolidator software with a B2B agent portal, sub-agents, net fares, markups, credit limits and wallets, so your network grows, not your back office.
